import sqlite3 import json import html from typing import List, Optional from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Request from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse from pydantic import BaseModel, Field import uvicorn app = FastAPI(title="Recipe Sharing App API") DB_FILE = "db.sqlite3" # --- Database Setup --- def init_db(): with sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE) as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recipes ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL, ingredients TEXT NOT NULL, instructions TEXT NOT NULL ) ''') cursor.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS comments ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, recipe_id INTEGER NOT NULL, comment TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (recipe_id) REFERENCES recipes (id) ) ''') cursor.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ratings ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, recipe_id INTEGER NOT NULL, rating INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (recipe_id) REFERENCES recipes (id) ) ''') conn.commit() init_db() # --- Pydantic Models --- class RecipeCreate(BaseModel): title: str = Field(..., max_length=1000) ingredients: List[str] = Field(..., max_length=100) # Bound list size instructions: str = Field(..., max_length=10000) class CommentCreate(BaseModel): comment: str = Field(..., max_length=2000) class RatingCreate(BaseModel): rating: int = Field(..., ge=1, le=5) class CommentSchema(BaseModel): comment: str class RecipeSchema(BaseModel): id: str title: str ingredients: List[str] instructions: str comments: List[CommentSchema] avgRating: Optional[float] # --- Helper Functions --- def get_db(): conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE) conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return conn def validate_id(recipe_id: str): """Ensure recipeId is a numeric string to prevent unexpected SQL behavior and ensure it's treated as an integer by the DB.""" if not recipe_id.isdigit(): raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid recipe ID format") return int(recipe_id) # --- Routes --- @app.get("/recipes", response_class=HTMLResponse) async def get_recipes_overview(): try: conn = get_db() cursor = conn.cursor() # Parameterized query (though no user input here) query = ''' SELECT r.id, r.title, AVG(ra.rating) as avg_rating FROM recipes r LEFT JOIN ratings ra ON r.id = ra.recipe_id GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, r.id DESC ''' cursor.execute(query) recipes = cursor.fetchall() conn.close() #     {instructions_esc}

    Back to Overview """ return HTMLResponse(content=html_content) except HTTPException: raise except Exception: raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Internal server error") @app.post("/recipes/{recipeId}/comments", status_code=201) async def add_comment(recipeId: str, payload: CommentCreate): rid = validate_id(recipeId) try: conn = get_db() cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute("SELECT id FROM recipes WHERE id = ?", (rid,)) if not cursor.fetchone(): conn.close() raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Recipe not found") cursor.execute("INSERT INTO comments (recipe_id, comment) VALUES (?, ?)", (rid, payload.comment)) conn.commit() conn.close() return {"message": "Comment added successfully"} except HTTPException: raise except Exception: raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid input") @app.post("/recipes/{recipeId}/ratings", status_code=201) async def add_rating(recipeId: str, payload: RatingCreate): rid = validate_id(recipeId) try: conn = get_db() cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute("SELECT id FROM recipes WHERE id = ?", (rid,)) if not cursor.fetchone(): conn.close() raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Recipe not found") cursor.execute("INSERT INTO ratings (recipe_id, rating) VALUES (?, ?)", (rid, payload.rating)) conn.commit() conn.close() return {"message": "Rating added successfully"} except HTTPException: raise except Exception: raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid input") if __name__ == "__main__": uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=5000)
